commit.message:
Fix: live-wrap finds where a self-closing element ends (#852) (#916)

find_closing_line counted tags per line, so a self-closing element split
across lines, or one with `>` inside a prop, never balanced and fell back
to start + 50 lines. The wrap then swallowed the neighbouring source.

The closer is now found by a character scan that follows each opening tag
to its own `>` across lines: quoted values and `{...}` expressions inside
the tag are skipped (JS strings, template literals and backslash escapes
inside an expression included), and a closing tag whose `>` starts the
next line closes there.

An element that never closes has no end line. Wrap and insert-after refuse
with a structured element_unclosed fallback error instead of guessing, and
insert-before still works from the start line. With --text, an unclosed
candidate is matched over the same look-ahead window as before, for
matching only.

Refs #852 (Case 1; Case 2 is not reproduced). Also covers the overshoot
half of #875.

Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Element location: first line containing query (skipping lines starting with `<!--`,`{/*`,`//` or containing `data-impeccable-variant`), resolve opener (`/<([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)(?=[\s/>]|$)/` on the line, else walk back ≤10 lines; a differently-named opener aborts; the opener name is compared to `--tag` ignoring ASCII case, so `--tag input` matches an `<Input>` component), closer by same-name depth counting (`<tag`, `<tag …/>`, `</tag>`) over a character scan that follows each opening tag to its own `>` across lines, skipping quoted values and `{…}` expressions inside it (inside `{…}` a backtick opens a template literal that may span lines; `"` or `'` counts as a string only when it closes on the same line and is not an apostrophe after a letter or digit; backslash escapes apply inside those strings; comments inside `{…}` are not lexed, so a quote or backtick in one is read as a delimiter); a `</tag` whose `>` starts the next line closes there; depth is tested at end of line. No fallback: an element that never closes has no end line, so wrap, insert `after`, and insert at either position on the Svelte component path exit 1 with `element_unclosed`; insert `before` proceeds from the start line, and `candidates[].endLine` is `null`. With `--text` (≥8 normalized chars): all candidates, filter by text (spaced or compact normalization of tag/JSX-stripped body; an unclosed candidate's body is `start..min(start+50, last)`, used for matching only).
